text:
elaine: Quick follow-up from Verdant postmortem. Root cause: NAT hairpin + TCP window scaling mismatch caused bursts of RSTs when connections crossed the customer edge -> triggered mass connection churn and tenant isolation in the Dedicated pool. I collected the remediation items below.

tom: Can you list owners & rough dates so we can slot into sprint?

elaine: Short list: infra prefix + SNAT validation, runtime soft-evict + backoff, regression harness, customer coordination, and a monthly pattern scan. Assignments: Tom infra, Ravi runtime, DevEx harness, Elaine customer comms.

ravi: I'll own runtime changes (TICKET-7011). Plan: add a soft-evict flow that marks connections as "suspect" for 30s, staggered recon attempts per-tenant, and a TCP window resync probe before hard eviction. Prototype this week.

devex: I'll build a minimal harness (TICKET-7012) to replay NAT hairpin + TCP window scale mismatch; will wire it into nightly CI. ETA harness demo Thu.

tom: Infra TICKET-7013: add SNAT consistency checks, tighten prefix filters, and add a lightweight TCP health probe that fails fast on excessive RSTs. PR target Fri EOD; canary Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC on 5% of peered prefixes. Need a rollback plan.

ops-bot: infra-bot: created TICKET-7011, TICKET-7012, TICKET-7013 by elaine.

sre-lead: Success criteria to attach to tickets: 1) synthetic hairpin replay shows no tenant isolation for 10m; 2) soft-evict reduces mass hard-evictions by >=90% in canary; 3) regression test added to nightly CI.

ravi: Runtime snippet (pseudo):
```
def handle_peer_change(peer):
  for c in conns.to_peer(peer):
    c.mark_suspect(ttl=30)
    schedule(c.soft_close, delay=rand(5,12))
    if tcp_window_mismatch(c):
      c.run_resync_probe()
```

tom: Infra will gate DROP rules behind an allowlist during canary. PR will include iptables snippet and the probe job.

devex: Harness will assert per-tenant eviction spikes and check that suspect->hard-evict rate <= 0.1 under replay. I'll add logs matcher and a demo job for Thu sync.

elaine: Customer comms (TICKET-7014): I'll send a targeted note with recommended NAT/SNAT checks and propose a short maintenance window for their edge team to validate SNAT behavior. Target send Mon EOD.

sre-lead: I'll be on rotation for the canary and will add a Kibana saved query for quick checks: kql: message:eviction AND tenant_id:* AND timestamp:[now-30m TO now].

elaine: Monthly pattern scan (TICKET-7015) proposed to surface repeated hairpin/NAT signals across customers. I'll own initial schedule and dashboard.

tom: Timeline recap:
- TICKET-7012 (harness): demo Thu
- TICKET-7011 (runtime): prototype Wed, PR Mon
- TICKET-7013 (infra): PR Fri EOD, canary Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC
- TICKET-7014 (comms): Mon EOD
- TICKET-7015 (scan): initial schedule Tue

elaine: Thanks team  Will create sprint cards and calendar invite for Thu handoff. Ping me in-thread to reassign. :thumbsup:
